summary: Tested 3 new features: 1) All Users tab in Admin Dashboard 2) Edit Permissions (Shield) in All Users tab 3) Language Switcher in Sidebar. Backend: All 13 API tests PASSED. Frontend: All Users tab works with search functionality. Language Switcher works correctly (EN/AR toggle). However, found a BUG - Edit Permissions modal doesn't open from All Users tab shield button.

ui_bugs.issue: Edit Permissions modal doesn't open when clicking Shield button in All Users tab. The modal is only rendered inside the Companies tab section (line 1087-1195) but not in the Users tab section.
ui_bugs.fix_suggestion: Move the Edit Permissions modal outside the Companies tab conditional block OR duplicate it inside the Users tab section

GET /api/admin/all-users.details: Returns all users from all companies with company_name enriched. Passwords excluded from response.

PUT /api/admin/users/{user_id}/permissio.details: Updates user permissions successfully. Validates permission IDs, returns 400 for invalid permissions, 404 for non-existent users.

GET /api/admin/permissions.details: Returns all 10 available permissions with id, name_en, name_ar fields.

GET /api/admin/dashboard.details: Returns statistics including total_users, total_companies, active_subscriptions.

Authentication.details: All endpoints properly return 401 for unauthenticated requests.

all_users_tab.details: Tab visible in Admin Dashboard with 69 users displayed. Shows Name, Email, Company, Role, Status, Permissions, Actions columns.

user_search.details: Search input works - typing 'admin' filters to 20 users matching the query.

shield_button_in_all_users.details: Shield button (Edit Permissions) present but clicking it doesn't open the permissions modal. This is because the modal component is not rendered inside the Users tab section.

language_switcher_sidebar.details: Globe button with 'Change Language' label toggles between English and Arabic. UI correctly switches to RTL layout with Arabic text.

companies_tab.details: Companies tab shows company list with Eye (View Users) and Power (Toggle Status) buttons.

action_items: FIX (HIGH): Move Edit Permissions modal rendering outside the Companies tab conditional block in AdminDashboard.jsx. The modal at lines 1087-1195 is inside `activeTab === 'companies'` section but needs to be accessible from Users tab too.
ALTERNATIVE: Duplicate the Edit Permissions modal rendering inside the `activeTab === 'users'` section at line 1268
critical_code_review_comments: BUG: AdminDashboard.jsx - The editingUserPermissions modal (lines 1087-1195) is only rendered inside the Companies tab section. When clicking Shield button from All Users tab, the state is set but modal doesn't show because it's inside the wrong conditional block.
The handleEditPermissions function is called correctly from All Users tab but modal rendering is scoped to Companies tab only.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Users tab works but Edit Permissions modal doesn't open from it. The bug is in AdminDashboard.jsx - the modal is rendered inside Companies tab section only. Backend APIs all working correctly. Language Switcher tested and working.

rca_of_the_issue.bug: Edit Permissions modal not opening from All Users tab
rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: In AdminDashboard.jsx, the Edit Permissions modal component (lines 1087-1195) is rendered inside the `{activeTab === 'companies' && ...}` conditional block. When user clicks Shield button from All Users tab, `handleEditPermissions(usr)` sets `editingUserPermissions` state correctly, but since the tab is 'users' not 'companies', the modal rendering code is not executed.
reproduction_steps: 4. Click Shield icon in Actions column for any user
5. EXPECTED: Edit Permissions modal should open
rca_of_the_issue.suggested_fix: Move the Edit Permissions modal rendering block (lines 1087-1195) to be a sibling of the tab content, rendered whenever `editingUserPermissions` is not null, regardless of which tab is active. This way it will show up when clicking from either Companies or All Users tab.
